summary: Cult of Chucky is a 2017 American supernatural psychological slasher film written and directed by Don Mancini. It is the seventh installment of the Child's Play franchise and follows the 2013 film Curse of Chucky. Brad Dourif returns as Chucky, joined by a supporting cast of returning performers from the earlier films.
one_line: A 2017 American supernatural slasher film by Don Mancini, the seventh installment of the Chucky franchise.
key_facts: Cult of Chucky is a 2017 American supernatural psychological slasher film.
Cult of Chucky was written and directed by Don Mancini.
Cult of Chucky is the seventh installment of the franchise.
Cult of Chucky follows the 2013 film Curse of Chucky.
Brad Dourif stars as Chucky in Cult of Chucky.
The supporting cast of Cult of Chucky includes Fiona Dourif, Alex Vincent, Jennifer Tilly and Summer H. Howell.
Fiona Dourif, Alex Vincent, Jennifer Tilly and Summer H. Howell are returning cast members from the previous six installments.
The film is described as a supernatural psychological slasher film.
